items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1969-03-24
items.q: So sure enough, a friend of mine, cab driver Pickle, came and got me, helped to bring me upstairs.

ctx.x: We buried on the 27th of June 1966. And it was during that time before she died that I started to take the seat. My legs had went bad on me. I used to have to use a chair to slide around on. You know, taking foot in this slide wherever I had to go to the bathroom. I had to slide in with the chair pulling along with me. So, I had gotten sold a week back then. Yeah, I was in the hospital about six weeks. I came out after July 4th. Must have been about a week after the 4th of July. Came home. I still couldn't do…
Do you have any plans for, do you foresee that you will be going on any more tours?
